decision.justification: The series is seasonally dominated with strong trend, but the 19 models carry highly correlated errors (mean_corr 0.927, only 2 independent groups) and the ranking is unstable (Kendall tau -0.084). In this regime, the plain mean of the full pool acts as a robust aggregator that averages out the small per-model noise without overfitting to any single window's ranking. Four alternative strategies (best_single ETS, trimmed_mean, topk_per_horizon weights, and the seeded baselines) all scored worse, confirming that no subset or reweighting adds value when the models are this redundant. The leader's 'separated' verdict over the runner-up (margin 0.00114) further supports accepting it.
